title: Overcharged TNT Cannon

body:
💣 Overcharged TNT-Cannon

Why punch trees when you can obliterate them from 50 blocks away?

💥 The Mod You Didn’t Know You Needed

Tired of boring combat? Bows too weak? Crossbows too quiet?
Introducing the Overcharged TNT-Cannon — the world’s most questionably safe ranged weapon!

This isn’t your grandpa’s TNT. This is explosive firepower, supercharged and handheld.

🎯 How to Use (Without Blowing Yourself Up... Probably)

Right-click: Pew! A modest TNT shot — enough to scare your friends and redecorate your house.

Hold & Release: Now we’re talking. The cannon charges up, sending TNT farther, faster, and with a blast radius that says “goodbye” to anything nearby.

The longer you hold, the more power it stores... until it’s basically a miniature nuclear warhead (minus the fallout, plus the fun).

⚠️ Disclaimer: Side effects may include crater addiction, loss of friendship, and spontaneous laughter.

🧨 Why You’ll Love It

Turns peaceful building sessions into cinematic warzones.

Makes Creepers jealous and Endermen teleport away in fear.

Perfect for PvP, mob control, or “accidentally” destroying your friend’s house.

Scientifically proven to increase your coolness by 300%.

Works seamlessly on both clients and servers! (Yes, your entire SMP can now descend into glorious, explosive chaos.)

🧩 Requirements

🧱 Fabric Loader

🧩 Fabric API
(If you’re not using Fabric... you’re missing out on the explosions.)

🧱 Compatibility

Currently available for:

🧨 Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.5

Sadly, that’s the only version for now — but don’t worry!
We’re working hard (and totally not just blowing stuff up for testing purposes) to bring the Overcharged TNT-Cannon to other Minecraft versions soon!

🧠 Pro Tips

Charge your shot for maximum chaos.

Don’t use it indoors. Trust me.

Do not ask what happens if you shoot straight up. (you’ll find out.)

The Overcharged TNT-Cannon isn’t just a weapon, it’s a lifestyle choice.
Because sometimes, bows just don’t explode enough.

So grab your cannon, light the fuse, and show the world what “creative destruction” really means!
